entry.name: AdeptusMechanicus/VoicesInTheCodeDescription
entry.value: Increases the morale loss of enemy units adjacent to Sicarian Infiltrators and Sicarian Ruststalkers.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/HammerOfWrathDescription
entry.value: Grants Scout Sentinels, Attilan Rough Riders and Bullgryns the ability to perform more devastating attacks.

entry.name: Eldar/CrystalTargetingMatrixDescription
entry.value: Grants Fire Prisms, Hornets, Vypers, Wave Serpents and War Walkers the ability to temporarily increase their accuracy.

entry.name: Eldar/GhostwalkMatrixDescription
entry.value: Allows Fire Prisms, Hornets, Vypers, Wave Serpents and War Walkers to move through cover.

entry.name: Eldar/HoloFieldsDescription
entry.value: Grants Fire Prisms, Hornets, Vypers and Wave Serpents invulnerable damage reduction after having moved.

entry.name: Eldar/SpiritStonesDescription
entry.value: Reduces the morale loss of Fire Prisms, Hornets, Vypers, War Walkers and Wave Serpents.

entry.name: Eldar/StarEnginesDescription
entry.value: Increases the movement of Fire Prisms, Hornets, Scorpions, Vypers, War Walkers and Wave Serpents.

entry.name: Eldar/VectoredEnginesDescription
entry.value: Grants Fire Prisms, Hornets, Vypers, War Walkers, Wave Serpents and Scorpions the ability to temporarily increase their armour against enemy ranged weapons.

entry.name: Necrons/HammerOfWrathDescription
entry.value: Grants Destroyer Lords, Tomb Blades, Canoptek Reanimators, Canoptek Spyders, Transcendent C'tan, Triarch Praetorians and Triarch Stalkers the ability to perform more devastating attacks.

entry.name: Orks/HammerOfWrathDescription
entry.value: Grants Deff Dreads, Deffkoptas, Gargantuan Squiggoths, Gorkanauts, Killa Kans, Squighog Boyz and Warbikers the ability to perform more devastating attacks.

entry.name: Tyranids/HammerOfWrathDescription
entry.value: Grants Exocrines, Gargoyles, Haruspexes, Hive Crones, Hive Tyrants, Maleceptors, Norn Emissaries, Scythed Hierodules, Tervigons, Trygons, Tyrannocytes and Tyrannofexes the ability to perform more devastating attacks.
